app_store_connect.subtitle: Exploratory Self-Report
app_store_connect.description: APGI Explorer is a local, exploratory self-report questionnaire with 35 items and descriptive response summaries. Results are not validated psychological measures, diagnoses or predictions. Personal answers stay on your device. The app connects to api.apgiframework.com for public API version and release metadata. Research participation and paid products are unavailable in this release.
app_store_connect.app_store_review_notes: Personal questionnaire answers and item histories are stored locally. Public API version and metadata are requested without participant credentials or answers. Research mode, score indexing, and paid products are disabled.
app_store_connect.whats_new: Corrected local scoring and saved results; descriptive labels; local answer history; API connection status; paid products and Spotlight score indexing disabled.
